title: Kagamine Len — Prince Of The Stage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Luka! Hi, MEIKO! I didn't know you two were coming to this!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, Rin, Miku. I see that you two were invited as well♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! Hehe. I've really been looking forward to this!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hey, look.
There's a flower broach placed on every seat.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
Let's see, where's my seat? Oh, I get an orange one!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mine's green.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I got a red one. How about you, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Mine's a very musical color♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, we call it pink...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, it's starting!

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: Thanks for your patience, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And thank you for being in attendance today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I took a bit of a break to come up with some new ideas for events and stuff, but I'm back to doing shows like usual starting with this one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I have some really fun stuff in store for you today too, so please enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And we'll be using those broaches on your seats during the show, so don't lose them, okay♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Now, let's have some fun!
Start the music!
song00002_off_f

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len really knows how to get a crowd going, huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He really does! And I can't wait to see how we'll be using our broaches!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh wow! It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. His talent for touching people's hearts is quite something, no♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone, it's time!
Get your broaches ready!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, here we go!
What do we do? What do we do?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
In my hand is a very special box!
And it's full of the same flowers that are on your broaches!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll be drawing two flowers from it.
If your broach happens to be the same color, you get to dance with me during the next song!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But I can't see what's inside!
Now, let's see who are lucky guests are!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, this is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Pick an orange one! An ORANGE one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Everybody with... Ta-daah!
Orange and green broaches!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait! Luka and MEIKO don't get to come with us...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Rest assured, my red and pink flowers!
We need you to be our chorus!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Now we all get to have fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, oranges and greens, let's start by practicing a little!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, your show was awesome!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We had so much fun!
Thank you for inviting us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I need to thank you guys too!
You all sang and danced so well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's because you created such a good vibe for us!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you really did.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Your show also reminded me of how performances can vary so much based on who's on stage♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For example, MEIKO likes to become one with the audience and is incredibly talented at doing so...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Len seems to know how to create a fun atmosphere with some unique ideas while throwing in a little fan service.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You hit the nail right on the head, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so cool...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (And if I could learn a lot by doing shows with Len!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: L-Len...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've been thinking about doing some shows on my own but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Would it be okay if we did some shows together?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I appreciate the offer, but are you sure...? It won't be a solo performance if I'm there with you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's totally fine! I want the audience to have as much fun as they possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I feel there's a lot that I can learn from you about being an idol, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, alright! In that case, I gladly accept!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Len!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see what you two have in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make this a great livestream, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!
